programme.desc: Dihoskan oleh Kak Lina Pom Pom yang lantang, No Filter bongkar kisah panas selebriti melalui soalan pedas tanpa tapis dari kontroversi hingga perubahan imej semuanya dibongkar

programme.title: Chalie
programme.desc: Jiwa wanita susah untuk difahami-kisah Chalie yang menghadapi konflik diri sehingga menyebabkan dia terpaksa 'berpisah' dengan suami tercinta.Namun dia mula melalui pelbagai cabaran tanpa suaminya di sisi

programme.title: Harta Dalam Stor - EP 9
programme.desc: Ikuti hos Nabil Mahir dan Azhar Sulaiman menerjah stor kediaman selebriti tanahair untuk mencari barang-barang yang boleh digunapakai dan dijual.

programme.title: RASA Projek Gerenti Jadi - EP 6
programme.desc: Program masakan ini memerlukan selebriti jemputan membawa ibu atau bapa mereka menjelajah Malaysia bagi merasa sendiri masakan kegemaran ibu bapa masing-masing.

programme.title: You Know Nothing About Sports - EP 1
programme.desc: Kali ini dalam siri You Know Nothing, Sherry teringin untuk belajar sukan pula. Sherry akan berpasangan dengan seorang selebriti popular untuk mempelajari sukan baru yang akan di ajar oleh atlet terkenal.

programme.title: Carta 10 - EP 7
programme.desc: Carta 10 merupakan sebuah program majalah berbentuk carta mengenai perkara yang menarik di bumi Malaysia.

programme.title: Cheap Thrills - EP 11
programme.desc: Syafa dan Pink Azwan menjelajah hampir seluruh semenanjung Malaysia mencari tempat-tempat yang sesuai untuk healing dan menjenguk lokasi di mana kita boleh shopping barang-barang yang tak lapuk dek zaman.

programme.title: Kak Lina Ter-Over Take Over - EP 4
programme.desc: Saksikan gelagat Kak Lina Pom Pom yang kecoh dan lucu bersama para tetamu jemputan melakukan cabaran istimewa yang pasti mencuit hati anda sekeluarga.

programme.title: Impiana: Makeover Ruang Selebriti - EP 1
programme.desc: 10 selebriti yang terpilih akan berpeluang mendapat sentuhan hiasan dalaman dengan pelbagai perabot pilihan mengikut citarasa melalui perbincangan bersama pakar hiasan dalaman.

programme.title: Seri Ferry Mart - EP 4
programme.desc: Sebuah Sitkom tempat kerja di sebuah pasar raya sibuk, penuh dengan gelak tawa dan situasi tidak dijangka. Saksikan Sherry Al- Hadad, Nabila Huda, Bell Ngasri & ramai lagi yang pasti mencuit hati anda.

programme.title: Polis Evo 3
programme.desc: Selepas serangan pengganas membunuh ratusan orang yang tidak bersalah, dua detektif ditugaskan untuk menyiasat. Mereka membongkar rahsia silam yang boleh membahayakan semua yang mereka sayangi.

programme.title: Aankh Micholi
programme.desc: Three cousins, Laadli Chibber, Bajrang Das Khatri and Shikhar Randhawa, embrace the warmth of a new city when they move to Mumbai, but they also face challenges that transform their lives.

programme.title: Naughty @ 40
programme.desc: Happy, a 40-year-old, marries Gauri, a childlike woman, and frustration leads him into the arms of a model. When Gauri finds out about their relation, she decides to change her attitude.

programme.title: Meherbaan
programme.desc: Meherbaan is the story of a family man, who has to decide between commitment, ethics and love between his 2 women.

programme.title: Street Dancer 3d

programme.title: Kahan Shuru Kahan Khatam
programme.desc: A woman rejects her arranged marriage, sparking a chaotic chase as she tries to escape the wedding, while the groom and his family try to catch her.

programme.title: Eleven

programme.title: Phool

programme.title: Extraa Shots Kabir Singh
programme.desc: Watch behind the scenes and meet the cast and crew of the movie.

programme.title: The Lychee Road

programme.title: Red Line

programme.title: It's a Wonderful Life
programme.desc: Yam Tai Foon, a wealthy man is unhappy with his son's failed marriage and Kwai's dream of being a comic artist. He pins hopes on his daughter, On, but she returns from France with wild Ruberto.

programme.title: CJ7
programme.desc: When a poor laborer picks up a toy for his son from a dumpster, the events that follow teach them about the true nature of family and things money can't buy.

programme.title: Wish Comes True
programme.desc: Fei meets young talent Wai who suffers from a rare disease, and helps Wai find his lost love. Even when they know the drug treating Wai is ineffective, they choose to embrace hope and love together.

programme.title: YOLO
programme.desc: After years of self-neglect, Le Ying decides to embrace life anew. Meeting a boxing coach sparks her desire for a fresh start. Despite the challenges ahead, she embarks on a transformative journey.

programme.title: Caught In Time
programme.desc: Based on a string of real robberies and murder cases, a detective engages in a mouse-and-cat game with the 'Eagle Gang', a group of sophisticated, well-trained and ruthless robbers.

programme.title: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: When an unidentified corpse is found at a residential unit, the residents fear that its presence will turn their home into an ill-fated house, leading to a chaotic endeavor to remove the body.

programme.title: Resurrection
programme.desc: In a world without dreams, a monster wanders through a vanishing dreamworld. A woman who can see its hidden visions ventures deep into its dreams to seek the buried truth.

programme.title: The Brotherhood of Rebel
programme.desc: Chai, a triad member, helps his friend Meow flee after Meow's attempt to kill his triad boss. 17 years later, their paths cross when Meow's life is in danger again. Will Chai choose loyalty over duty?

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A traffic accident that resulted in a taxi driver being blinded inexplicably connects a group of unrelated people together, including blind masseurs from a massage center, a young man & a couple.

programme.title: Detective Chinatown 1900
programme.desc: In 1900s San Francisco, the murder of a white woman in Chinatown ignites public outrage. Two Chinese detectives race against time to uncover the true killer amid mounting tension and danger.

programme.title: The White Storm 3: Heaven or Hell
programme.desc: Two undercover cops successfully develop a brotherly bond with a Thai drug lord. When the police busts the syndicate, the drug lord discovers that there is betrayal within his circle of trust...

programme.title: Chilli Laugh Story
programme.desc: Coba turns his mother's chili sauce into a trendy commodity during the pandemic, with the help of the whole family. The business booms online, bringing them unexpected success and unity.

programme.title: Fly Me to the Moon
programme.desc: New Hong Kong immigrants Yuan and her sister face identity crises, poverty and their father's drug addiction. Even as they separate from their father, Yuan finds his traits mirrored in her loved ones.

programme.title: Life Must Go On
programme.desc: When the midnight gymnasium programme for wayward teenage girls is at risk of closing down due to funding, social worker Yanki puts together a dodgeball team to compete in a match to save it.

programme.title: Honey Money Phony
programme.desc: Deceived by a romantic scam and burdened with a massive debt, Lin partners with con artist Ouyang to reclaim her money. Together, they defy the odds and discover an unexpected love in the process.

programme.title: Kung Fu Hustle
programme.desc: This award-winning film directed, written and starred in by Stephen Chow, depicts the adventure of a wannabe gangster who aspires to join the notorious Axe Gang.

programme.title: Victim(s)
programme.desc: After a ruthless Kuala Lumpur student murders his classmate, the victim's mother and the killer's mother uncover hidden truths about their sons and face very different paths of grief and torment.

programme.title: Table for Six 2
programme.desc: Bernard and Lung plan to get married when their eldest brother is away. Yet, the weddings spiral into a chaotic battleground with escalating family drama, creating a messy affair for all involved!

programme.title: Bodyguards and Assassins
programme.desc: Winner of 8 HKFA awards & featuring an all-star cast, this film depicts an elite team guarding Dr Sun Yat Sen in Hong Kong, as he discusses plans to overthrow the Qing dynasty.

programme.title: Wolf Pack

programme.title: All's Well End's Well (Extended version)
programme.desc: In this Hong Kong comedy, three Chang brothers learn love needs care, not haste or selfishness. This extended cut adds a shootout scene missing from the 2016 Lunar New Year release

programme.title: All's Well End's Well Too
programme.desc: Another super comedy directed by Clifton Ko about more farcical couplings, mistaken identities, infidelities, and arranged marriages set in the Sung Dynasty.

programme.title: Detective Vs. Sleuths

programme.title: The Kid From The Big Apple 2: Before We Forget

programme.title: Ne Zha 2
programme.desc: After a catastrophe, the souls of Ne Zha and Ao Bing are saved, but their bodies will soon dissipate. Master Tai Yi seeks to restore them with the Seven-Coloured Lotus, hoping to change their destiny.

programme.title: Wolf Hiding
programme.desc: A cold-blooded killer vows to take revenge for her sister who was killed by a crime gang. Dealing with the police and the triad at the same time, a final battle between good and evil has just begun!

programme.title: OMG! Mom's Big News
programme.desc: A mother in her 50s unexpectedly becomes pregnant, turning her family's quiet life upside down. As they prepare for the baby's arrival, chaos and laughter follow, teaching them love and acceptance.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time in Hong Kong
programme.desc: Helmed by four Best Actors and set in Hong Kong in the 1970s, this exciting action film charts how the ICAC dealt with corruption within the police force in its early stages of establishment.

programme.title: The Lychee Road
programme.desc: A single lychee triggers a Tang Dynasty "Mission Impossible"! Junior official Li races 1,000 miles in three days to satisfy a consort's craving - an epic ride of tension, humour and biting satire!

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: Set three years after Dragon Inn, this sequel depicts a new inn that has risen from the ashes - one staffed by treasure seekers in disguise.

programme.title: The Last Dance
programme.desc: Debt-ridden wedding planner, Sheng, finds a lifeline as he transitions into a funeral planner. Inspired by the respected Master Wen, Sheng gradually changes his attitude towards his career and life.

programme.title: Confinement
programme.desc: A pregnant painter hires a confinement nanny, but inexplicable incidents start happening in the house as her one-month confinement begins, threatening her and her baby daughter...

programme.title: Stuntman
programme.desc: A washed-up stunt director is struggling to find his way in the changing film industry. He risks everything to make a comeback, while striving to mend his relationship with his estranged daughter.

programme.title: Rob N Roll
programme.desc: A ruthless bandit plots a major heist which is joined by two dispirited men inadvertently. Their ad-hoc and dramatic robbery lands them in a fierce police pursuit, putting their lives on the line!

programme.title: The Narrow Road
programme.desc: The owner of a small cleaning company, Chak, experiences a tough time during the pandemic. When he employs single mother Candy as his assistant, she became his saving grace.

programme.title: Customs Frontline
programme.desc: The Hong Kong Customs officers uncover illegal weapons on a cargo ship linked to an international conflict. Elite agents go undercover and reveal a multinational operation with ties closer to home.

programme.title: Little Red Sweet
programme.desc: A family running a Chinese dessert shop faces upheaval when the mother suffers a devastating stroke. This heartfelt journey reveals the strength of family bonds, sacrifices, and resilience.

programme.title: Operation Hadal
programme.desc: Deep-sea special forces and the submarine 'Long Jing' join forces to stop an international super-submarine conspiracy, battling through enemy ambushes and treacherous depths in a thrilling showdown.

programme.title: Trouble Girl
programme.desc: Down with ADHD, Xiao Xiao faces school bullies and family issues. Her teacher Paul is her solace, but when she witnesses a secret between her mother and Paul, it adds complexity to her emotions.

programme.title: Death Notice
programme.desc: The Police sets up a special task force to track down a serial killer who leaves death notices stating when, how and who he will murder. In the process, they expose an even bigger conspiracy behind.

programme.title: Leap
programme.desc: At the 2008 Beijing Olympics, former volleyball legend Lang Ping coached Team USA to a controversial win over China. She later returned to rebuild China's team and won gold at Rio 2016.

programme.title: Article 20
programme.desc: Prosecutor Han Ming battles a case of intentional injury, risking all for justice. In a gripping finale, he transforms it into a fight for fairness, defending what is right.

programme.title: Project Gutenberg
programme.desc: The HK police is hunting for a counterfeiting gang led by a mastermind known as Painter. They recruit artist Lee Man to help in their quest, but the real identity of Painter surprises everyone.

programme.title: Once in a Blue Moon
programme.desc: Mei Zhen's family appears to get along but harbours secrets - she struggles at work, her brother hides his separation and their mother fears her past will affect them. Can they overcome these hurdles?

programme.title: All U Need is Love
programme.desc: When a luxury hotel in Hong Kong suddenly becomes a Coronavirus superspreader, guests & the staff are faced with a 14-day trial they may not survive.

programme.title: Panda Plan
programme.desc: Legendary kung fu star Jackie Chan adopts a panda names Hu Hu. When a crime syndicate places a bounty on the panda, Jackie, his agent, and Hu Hu's caretaker embark on a quest to outsmart the villains.

programme.title: Crisis Negotiators
programme.desc: Negotiator Wai is framed for murder. He takes hostages at the police station and demands talk with a former negotiator. As they engage in a tense battle of wits, their perspectives gradually shift.

programme.title: Leap
programme.desc: At the 2008 Beijing Olympics, former volleyball legend Lang Ping coached Team USA to a controversial win over China. She later returned to rebuild China's team and won gold at Rio 2016.

programme.title: L Storm
programme.desc: ICAC officer Luk and Inspector Lau are stuck in their investigation for bribery and money laundering cases. Framed for bribery, Luk risks everything to gather evidence to clear his name.

programme.title: 77 Heartwarmings
programme.desc: After breaking up with Adam, Eva focuses on her career, but Adam is determined to win her back and makes 77 attempts to do so. The situation worsens when a Thai movie idol courts Eva

programme.title: Stand Up Story
programme.desc: Mancer cares for his intellectually challenged father Wah. When Mancer finds solace in stand-up comedy, he turns his life's hardships into comedic gold, from school ridicule to pandemic woes.

programme.title: Inexternal
programme.desc: Ming falls into coma and is transported to a fantasy realm where old Master Turtle teaches him ancient boxing skill to defeat an evil boss. Meanwhile, Ming's mother finds a way to save her son.

programme.title: Mama's Affair
programme.desc: A Hong Kong drama written & directed by Kearen Pang, former talent manager Mei Fung retired to take care of her husband & son, but decides to return to work to find her value in life.

programme.title: Endgame
programme.desc: A remake from the Japanese movie Key of Life, Andy Lau, Xiao Yang and Wan Qian stars in this action comedy about the switched identities of an unsuccessful actor & a professional assassin.

programme.title: Ride On
programme.desc: Master Luo, a retired stuntman, trains his beloved horse Red Hare to be a stunt horse. But due to his debts, he might lose his horse, so he seeks help from his estranged daughter & her boyfriend.

programme.title: 97 Aces Go Places
programme.desc: When the reluctant son of a gangster is summoned home to avenge his father's death, he enlists his father's always-drunk bodyguard to help him out.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A Japanese security agent teams up with a master thief to recover counterfeit USD plates until a U.S. Embassy official betrays them and escapes to Korea with the prize.

programme.title: Table for Six
programme.desc: Three brothers reside in a home inherited from their late parents. The eldest brother insists on dinner together every night, but tensions rises when their girlfriends join the table.

programme.title: Song of Spring
programme.desc: This is a touching story about an 85-year-old mother caring for her 65-year-old daughter with Alzheimer's disease.

programme.title: Untouchable
programme.desc: Right-hand man to a Macau tycoon, Zun Fei, is torn between love and justice amid brutal underworld violence and power struggles. When a deadly gamble turns against him, his life hangs in the balance.

programme.title: Wish Comes True
programme.desc: Fei meets young talent Wai who suffers from a rare disease, and helps Wai find his lost love. Even when they know the drug treating Wai is ineffective, they choose to embrace hope and love together.

programme.title: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: When an unidentified corpse is found at a residential unit, the residents fear that its presence will turn their home into an ill-fated house, leading to a chaotic endeavor to remove the body.

programme.title: Man On the Edge
programme.desc: A triad leader assigns his right-hand man Ah Lok to take charge of the drug trafficking business, but Ah Lok is actually an undercover policeman who unveils a shocking political conspiracy.

programme.title: The Wig
programme.desc: Meng Zhong is a successful lawyer. During an investigation into a court case, he meets a girl who triggers his memories of a rainy night, revealing a long-hidden secret from 20 years ago...

programme.title: A Guilty Conscience
programme.desc: The highest grossing Chinese movie in Hong Kong history, the story tells of a barrister who swears to prove his client's innocence, going against one of the most powerful families in Hong Kong.

programme.title: High Forces
programme.desc: An A380 airliner is hijacked by gunmen on its maiden flight. Among the passengers is a security expert, whose daughter is one of the captives. Can he save all the passengers and avert the crisis?

programme.title: The Lychee Road
programme.desc: A single lychee triggers a Tang Dynasty "Mission Impossible"! Junior official Li races 1,000 miles in three days to satisfy a consort's craving - an epic ride of tension, humour and biting satire!

programme.title: Inner Senses
programme.desc: Haunted by recurring visions stemming from past traumas, Yan seeks help from psychiatrist Dr Jim. As she heals, Jim is haunted by the same disturbances when his suppressed memories resurface.

programme.title: Flashover
programme.desc: Based on a true story, an earthquake causes the gas pipes in an industrial park to break, resulting in explosions & fires in the area. Firefighters must fight to safeguard lives, including their own.

programme.title: My First Of May
programme.desc: Former squash champion Teng and his wife are devastated by their daughter's muscular dystrophy. Years later, the faint movement of her pinky finger gives them a small but powerful sign of hope.

programme.title: Ready o/r Knot
programme.desc: A couple who first meet at a wedding & have been together for five years, question the institution of marriage from opposing viewpoints. Should marriage always be the 'next step.'?

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: Set three years after Dragon Inn, this sequel depicts a new inn that has risen from the ashes - one staffed by treasure seekers in disguise.

programme.title: Good Game
programme.desc: A desperate internet cafe owner recruits his daughter, a washed-up action star and a failed pro gamer to form a ragtag esports team—all for a HK$500k tournament and one last, no-regrets shot.

programme.title: Wolf Pack
programme.desc: Specializing in overseas security jobs, The Wolf Pack discovers that terrorists are planning to destroy the country's energy source. Lead by Lao Diao, the pack must move out to stop them!

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Caught in an underground fight to pay off debts, talented boxer Jia Yang loses her Olympics dream and quits boxing. A decade later, Coach Li aids her comeback. Can Jia Yang resurrect her boxing dream?

programme.title: Table for Six 2
programme.desc: Bernard and Lung plan to get married when their eldest brother is away. Yet, the weddings spiral into a chaotic battleground with escalating family drama, creating a messy affair for all involved!

programme.title: I Did it My Way
programme.desc: As the secretive dark world of online drug trafficking increasingly targets Hong Kong, the police launches a risky and secret operation to bring down one of the most notorious drug lords in Asia.

programme.title: Leap
programme.desc: At the 2008 Beijing Olympics, former volleyball legend Lang Ping coached Team USA to a controversial win over China. She later returned to rebuild China's team and won gold at Rio 2016.

programme.title: The Panda Plan: Magical Tribe
programme.desc: Superstar Jackie Chan and panda Hu Hu are ambushed by robbers during their journey. In the chaos, they plunge off a cliff and discover a mysterious, isolated tribe hidden from the outside world.

programme.title: YOLO
programme.desc: After years of self-neglect, Le Ying decides to embrace life anew. Meeting a boxing coach sparks her desire for a fresh start. Despite the challenges ahead, she embarks on a transformative journey.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A huge hit in the HK, this typical Stephen Chow movie combines history, science fiction, martial arts & comedy elements makes it a fun watch.

programme.title: Time Still Turns the Pages
programme.desc: High school teacher Cheng finds a suicide note, triggering his childhood memories. He strives to prevent the suicide tragedy, while dealing with his wife's divorce request and his father's illness.

programme.title: Blades of the Guardians: Wind Rises in the Desert
programme.desc: Fugitive bounty hunter Dao Ma escorts the most wanted fugitive across the desert to Chang'an, only to be drawn into a plot that threatens war between the imperial court and the martial world.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Set in 2020 during the outbreak of COVID-19, the movie features interconnected stories of three women's lives as they navigate the uncertain future amongst their respective friends and families.

programme.title: Out of Order
programme.desc: A successful lawyer's secret affair turns into a nightmare when a corpse unexpectedly turns up in the hotel room, triggering a desperate cover-up that spirals into uncontrollable chaos.

programme.title: The Prosecutor
programme.desc: A young man is wrongly convicted of drug trafficking. A former cop turned prosecutor believes in his innocence and launches an investigation, risking his life and career to find the true perpetrator.

programme.title: I Still Remember
programme.desc: An uplifting sports drama focusing on a property agent who leads an aimless, unfulfilling life & his P.E teacher, as they seek to find purpose in their lives.

programme.title: Project Gutenberg
programme.desc: The HK police is hunting for a counterfeiting gang led by a mastermind known as Painter. They recruit artist Lee Man to help in their quest, but the real identity of Painter surprises everyone.

programme.title: 8 Bucks Tycoon
programme.desc: When a struggling painter receives a magical wallet that endlessly produces RM8 notes, his life transforms from hardship to luxury. However, is this miracle truly a blessing or a hidden curse?

programme.title: Hong Kong Family
programme.desc: A family torn apart 8 years ago during a disastrous winter solstice dinner reunites when their cousin returns home from England, hoping to mend relations after things had fallen apart.

programme.title: Mrs. Revenge
programme.desc: After Keung Hang Yu discovers her husband cheating, she's viciously attacked & left for dead. Then she woke up five years earlier, with the power to glimpse the future & a plan for revenge.

programme.title: Jejak Rasul - Sutera Laut Bicara Syahadah
programme.desc: Indonesia terkenal sebagai negara paling ramai jumlah penganut Islamnya. Ia diwarisi dari empayar kerajaan-kerajaan silam bermula dari empayar kerajaan Sriwijaya hinggalah kepada era kerajaan-kerajaan Islam.

programme.title: Religious Clip
programme.desc: Dalam episod kali ini, topik yang di sampaikan ialah “Haiwan Di Dalam Al-Quran - Ikan Kecil”. Bersama Ustaz Haji Zakaria yang akan membincangkan topik ini dengan lebih lanjut lagi

programme.title: Bacaan Al-quran V1
programme.desc: Bacaan ayat suci Al Quran

programme.title: Sunnah Nabi
programme.desc: Episod kali ini bersama Ustaz Tajid membawa topik "Kekeluargaan (Kasih Sayang)" dengan panel Ustaz Hassan Adli. Sunnah Nabi merupakan program keagamaan yang membawakan perbincangan santai namun ilmiah mengenai amalan sunnah dalam kehidupan seharian umat Islam. Program ini menampilkan pelbagai topik umum dan khusus berkaitan sunnah.

programme.title: Periuk Belanga
programme.desc: Episod kali ini bersama artis jemputan Ezzaty Abdullah yang akan menyajikan “Roti John” makanan berkonsepkan outdoor dan akan beraktiviti serta berkhemah di sebuah tapak perkhemahan yang dikelilingi oleh hutan.

programme.title: Jom Jalan
programme.desc: Jom Jalan akan membawa Selebriti tanah air ke serata pelusuk tanah air. Pada setiap episod Selebriti akan membawa penonton ke destinasi menarik yang meliputi lokasi percutian, lokasi bersejarah, membeli belah dan makanan tempatan. Pada minggu ni Jom Jalan membawa penonton ke negeri Pahang

programme.title: Asbab Al Nuzul
programme.desc: Episod ini akan menerangkan surah al-Quraisy. Asbab Al Nuzul yang akan menjelaskan persoalan-persoalan yang menyebabkan turunnya satu-satu ayat atau beberapa ayat untuk menerangkan peristiwa dan hukumnya turunnya ayat Al- Quran. Ia berkaitan dengan beberapa ayat untuk menerangkan hal yang berhubungan dengan peristiwa tertentu atau memberikan jawapan tertentu dalam bahagian dari ilmu tafsir Qur'an.

programme.title: Cerita Bintang
programme.desc: Cerita Bintang menampilkan artis-artis popular yang memberi peluang kepada peminat untuk lebih mengenali lebih rapat artis pujaan mereka. Episod kali ini Anis akan membawa penonton untuk menemu bual dengan Wany Hasrita.

programme.title: Jom Tengok
programme.desc: Jom Tengok adalah sebuah rancangan masakan yang bakal menampilkan Cef Bunga yang handal membuat Kek dan dalam episod kali ini menampilkan Jasmin Suraya sebagai selebriti jemputan dan mereka akan menghasilkan Kek Tiramisu.

programme.title: Alhamdulillah
programme.desc: Episod Alhamdulillah kali ini bersama Ummi Nazeera menemu bual usahawan Richiamo yang akan merungkai rahsia di sebalik kejayaan personaliti yang berjaya di Malaysia bagaimana permulaan kehidupan mereka untuk hidup dan kisah kejayaan seseorang usahawan dalam bidang yang diusahakan.

programme.title: Air Tangan Cef
programme.desc: Episod kali ini, Cef Fendi membawa penonton ke negeri Perak untuk mendekati proses membuat Kerisik dan akan berkongsi resepi ringkas membuat menu kerutuk itik.

programme.title: Jom Baca
programme.desc: Episod kali ini ustaz akan mengajar adik-adik membaca surah Quraish. Perkongsian yang santai dan pembukaan dimulakan dengan Q&A yang menjurus kepada permasalahan, kemusykilan harian yang dihadapi.Ustaz juga akan meminta adik-adik tersebut mengaji surah tersebut dan membetulkan bacaan mana yang salah. Ustaz juga akan mengupas kegunaan serta kebaikan surah tersebut dan akan ada soal jawab bersama adik-adik tersebut.

programme.desc: Zikir dan bacaan surah-surah lazim.

programme.desc: Dalam episod kali ini, topik yang di sampaikan ialah “Doa Pengampunan Dosa Sampai Husnul Khatimah”. Bersama Ustaz Hariri yang akan membincangkan topik ini dengan lebih lanjut lagi.

programme.title: Setiaku Di Sini
programme.desc: Sementara itu penipuan laporan perubatan Datuk K akhirnya terbongkar. Rayyan kecewa dan merasakan dirinya dianiaya oleh ibunya sendiri. Pada mulanya Datuk K juga ingin marah tetapi apabila dia melihat dari sudut positif, dia sedar apa yang dilakukan oleh Datin K adalah untuk kebaikan dirinya juga. Datin K merasa lega tetapi dia juga merasa simpati terhadap Fara yang tidak bersalah.

programme.title: Hidayah Klip
programme.desc: Hidayah Klip adalah sebuah rancangan majalah yang memaparkan penulisan lirik dalam sesebuah lagu bertemakan ketuhanan serta menyeru kearah keagamaan. Penulis lirik mencari bait-bait lirik untuk dijadikan sebuah lagu yang menyentuh hati. Episod kali ini bersama artis jemputan Heliza yang akan menemani Fakhrul Radhi dalam Hidayah Klip

programme.title: Oh! My Prince
programme.desc: Adlina bergegas ke hospital dan lega kerana Danial tidak terlibat dalam kemalangan itu. Danial dan Hairi masuk pertandingan badminton. Ketika latihan, Danial sengaja mencari peluang mendekati Adlina sehingga Hairi mula curiga. Semasa berada di perlawanan akhir, Danial yang pada mulanya kalah di set pertama mahu membuat perjanjian dengan Hairi. Sekiranya dia menang dalam perlawanan itu, dia mahu Hairi melupakan Adlina.

programme.title: Di Sisimu Aku
programme.desc: Qeena pergi ke firma guaman untuk urusan kerja. Qeena sangat terkejut dengar nama orang yang akan berurusan dengannya. Nama orang itu ialah Aman Zarul. Qeena tertanya sendiri, siapakah orang dimaksudkan. Adakah Aman Zarul yang pernah dia kenali bertahun lalu? Tiba-tiba muncul wanita bertanya tentang Aman kepada kerani, Qeena kenal wanita itu. Zeyra. Jika itu Zeyra. Maka, Aman Zarul yang akan berurusan dengan Qeena adalah Aman Zarul yang Qeena kenal. Qeena tidak mahu dan tidak sanggup bertemu dengan Aman. Qeena balik tanpa selesaikan urusan kerja.

programme.title: Inikah Dikatakan Cinta
programme.desc: Ziera terperanjat apabila ditegur oleh Mia. Mia meminta Ziera berubah dan meminta maaf di atas apa yang telah berlaku dulu. Ziera menuduh Mia yang menjadikan dia liar seperti hari ini. Mia yang mengajarnya mengenal ganja dan dadah. Dia pernah percayakan Mia tetapi Mia membunuh kepercayaannya. Mia cuba memujuk Ziera supaya bertaubat dan berubah tetapi Ziera pula mengajak Mia kembali ke zaman gelapnya dulu. Sementara itu Daus terpaksa membeli kembali jiwa Lyssa selepas Lyssa menuduh Daus masih menyimpan perasaan cinta terhadap isteri pertamanya itu.

Namun sebenarnya Jamil tidak tahu bahawa Datuk King dan Qistina sudah sepakat untuk mengenakan Jamil. Qistina mencadangkan untuk Jamil menukar pakaian lain yang lebih nampak segak. Jamil minta baju zaman 60annya semula. Namun Qistina menghalang dan minta pengawal peribadi untuk beri pakaian persis seperti seorang CEO. Selepas menukar pakaian, Jamil terasa dirinya kacak dan dia mula berjalan megah mengalahkan Tan Sri.

programme.title: Perempuan Tepi Jalan
programme.desc: Maya teruja bila Datuk Rizlan menghadiahkannya sebuah kondo dan mengizinkannya menghias kondo itu mengikut citarasanya sendiri. Namun kegembiraannya lenyap bila terserempak dengan Luth, kekasih lamanya, yang nampak bahagia dengan isteri dan anaknya, membuatkan Maya mula terfikir apa sebenarnya yang dia kejar? Meski hidup mewah, tapi jiwa muflis. Maya cuba melarikan diri namun dua orang bodyguard Datuk Rizlan yang ditugaskan mengejar sehingga Maya lari lintang pukang.

programme.desc: Sara rasa sunyi tanpa Dian. Sara pulang ke kampung untuk bertemu dengan opah. Ajib rasa terharu kerana Bib telah mengumpul dana menbiayai perubatan adiknya. Barulah Ajib menceritakan siapakah sebenar adiknya itu. Semua orang perasaan dengan perangai Syamil yang kian berubah. Affan mengikuti Sara pulang ke kampung. Nenek Sara tahu Affan sangat mencintai cucunya.

programme.title: Khilaf Asmara
programme.desc: Wan Su seorang janda, mempunyai anak perempuan bernama Hanim. Dia berkahwin dengan Dato Amri seorang duda mempunyai anak bernama Irma. Bagaimanapun mereka terpisah apabila Wan Su meninggalkan suaminya dan membawa Hanim bersamanya. Kini mereka telah berkeluarga. Irma bersama Luqman dan memiliki sebuah spa kecantikan. Hanim bersama Aizat dan mempunyai seorang anak bernama Tasya. Aizat mempunyai perniagaan Food Truck. Hanim kini bekerja sebagai PA kepada Luqman. Sejak itu penampilan dan sikapnya mula berubah.

programme.title: Khilaf Asmara
programme.desc: Irma berjaya mengesan skandal Luqman dengan Hanim. Irma mahu meninggalkan Luqman. Jerry sanggup mengeluarkan modal bagi Aizat memperkembangkan perniagaan Food Truck mereka. Di rumah, Hanim bergaduh besar dengan Aizat, dia menyalahkan Aizat kerana tidak mampu memberinya kemewahan. programme.title: Bidadari Tanpa Syurga
programme.desc: Aisyah turut mula mempersoalkan tindakan Azlan apabila beberapa perkara yang berlaku tidak selari dengan apa yang sering dilaungkan olehnya.

programme.title: Khilaf Asmara
programme.desc: Hanim gembira kerana mamanya sudah mula menerima hubungan dia dengan Luqman. Irma bertemu dengan Tasya untuk memujuknya. Irma menceritakan kisah hidupnya yang hampir serupa dengan apa yang dialami oleh Tasya sekarang. Aizat berterima kasih kepada Irma kerana dia berjaya menceriakan Tasya. Di pejabat, Luqman mengumumkan yang dia akan berkahwin dengan Hanim. Hanim gembira kerana akhirnya Luqman akan menjadi miliknya. Padahal di belakangnya, Luqman curang dengan perempuan lain.

programme.title: Sabarlah Duhai Hati
programme.desc: Affan cuba menenangkan Fira, namun campur tangan Shima dan Mak Teh menambah beban di bahu Fira.

programme.title: Mr Delicious
programme.desc: Cemburu dan salah faham meningkat ketika hubungan Aiman dan Melina semakin rapat. Zita, Zara dan Fina cuba mencari jawapan tentang masa depan mereka.

programme.title: Pemuja Rahsia
programme.desc: Adam, pelajar kolej yang popular dan juara debat, gemar menyertai marathon. Hawa, jiran Adam, sudah lama menyukai Adam selepas dia menyelamatkannya daripada lemas 18 tahun lalu. Namun, selepas kematian ayah Hawa, ibu Hawa, Suzana, enggan berhubung rapat dengan keluarga Adam, walaupun ayah Adam, Zul, beberapa kali cuba mendekatinya. Hawa percaya dia dan Adam ditakdirkan bersama, tetapi mereka jarang berkomunikasi. Hawa seorang gadis pendiam, gemar warna hitam, mekap pelik, dan muzik

programme.title: Mr Stalker… Saya Cintakan Awaklah!
programme.desc: Lutfiya menolak tawaran Syed Fuad untuk berkahwin dengan Raziq kerana tahu yang Raziq tidak menyintai dia. Setelah Lutfiya hampir pergi baru Raziq sedar yang dia sebenarnya menyintai Lutfiya dan bukan lagi Nadine. Tetapi dia terlambat kerana Lutfiya telah membuat keputusan untuk berhijrah ke Australia. Nadine kembali semula ke Kuala Lumpur setelah 3 tahun menyembunyikan diri di Terengganu. Nadine kembali dengan nama baru 'Nilla' dan mula berhijab. Nilla bekerja di sebuah butik milik Lulu dan ibu Nilla, Puan Surina. Ziyan, wartawan Prima Kota diberi tugasan untuk mencari semula cerita tentang Nadine. Ziyan gembira apabila diperkenalkan dengan seorang fotografer kacak bernama Zein Asyraf.

programme.title: Pendosa Ingin Ke Syurga
programme.desc: Abdullah meninggalkan keluarga bagi mencari rezeki di kota. Di Kota beliau dikenali sebagai Shawn, memperolehi kekayaan selepas melibatkan diri dengan gangterisma dan kelab malam. Di kampung, Aisyah isterinya yang ditinggalkan telah melahirkan seorang anak perempuan bernama Murni. 20 tahun kemudian akibat tekanan keluarga dan kemiskinan, Murni lari ke ibukota. Murni kemudiannya jatuh cinta dengan Shawn dan berkahwin. Perkahwinan mereka mendapat seorang zuriat lelaki bernama Adam. Shawn mulai berubah dan bertaubat. Setelah beberapa lama, Murni dan Shawn bercadang untuk kembali berjumpa dengan ibunya dan membawa anak mereka bersama. Sesampai di kampung, Shawn (Abdullah) menyedari gadis yang dikahwininya adalah anak kandungnya sendiri. Dia memohon ampun kepada isterinya Aisyah dan ibunya atas ketelanjurannya. Shawn kemudiannya berjumpa dengan seorang ustaz meminta nasihat, dia akhirnya meninggalkan keluarganya dan menghilangkan diri.

programme.title: What Would You Do?
programme.desc: Using hidden cameras, host John Quiñones observes and comments on how ordinary people behave when they are confronted with dilemmas that require them either to take action or to walk by and mind their own business. Various scenarios are created that force people to make split-second -- and often surprising -- decisions, and variations of the situation (such as changing the genders, races or clothing of the people involved) are often featured to see if different reactions are elicited. Examples of situations on the show include a waitress being harassed by her boss, and a drunken valet trying to park cars.
